purpose: Project-authorized identity, controlled invocation, enrollment and separate access/signing proofs.
use: Credentials, identities, signing, access rights, or commits and publications carrying an identity: use project-authorized identity and separate proofs.
semantic_conditions: No ambient or foreign credentials; authentication, write and signature acceptance verified separately.
mandatory_preconditions: Project-scoped credential reference, effective actor and attribution identity.
postconditions_verification: No raw secrets persisted; identity and signature of the actual object verified.
